# Paul Raises Eutychus (Acts 20:10)

## Emotional Focus
When someone falls or gets hurt, friends and Jesus can help.

## Key KJV
“Trouble not yourselves; for his life is in him.” (Acts 20:10)

## Gentle Retelling
Young Eutychus fell from a window while Paul was teaching. Paul hugged him and God brought him back to life. Everyone was comforted.

## Coloring Prompt
Paul gently holding Eutychus after he fell; friends looking on with hope and relief.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“God’s power works through His people to bring comfort.”
